name: Plantasonic Botanical DNA
description: The single source of truth for the visual identity of the Plantasonic installation. Every generation prompt, procedural variant, and renderer layer derives its look from this file. Nothing else should duplicate these values.

visualLanguage.summary: Hyper-detailed botanical specimens rendered as luminous, low-fidelity dream artifacts. Equal parts antique scientific illustration and retro-futurist pixel art.

palette.notes: Cool botanical greens form the base. Accents are reserved for audio-reactive highlights and bloom events. Color count is capped to preserve the indexed, dithered aesthetic.

background.notes: Background is intentionally near-black to maximize bloom and glow contrast against specimens.

lighting.notes: Light appears to emanate from within the plants rather than from an external source.

pixelDensity.notes: Assets are authored at high resolution but quantized to a coarse pixel grid for the signature lo-fi look.

dithering.notes: Ordered Bayer dithering preserves the retro print quality while keeping the color index low.

rules: subtle paper or film grain over every surface
veins, fibers and cellular detail must remain legible after quantization
texture.notes: Texture rules apply after color quantization but before bloom.

composition.framing: centered specimen with generous negative space
composition.notes: Single hero specimen per asset. Crowding is reserved for scene composition, not individual assets.

promptSuffix: botanical specimen, bioluminescent, dithered lo-fi pixel art, indexed 16 color palette, internal emissive lighting, soft bloom, film grain, centered composition, dark near-black background, hyper-detailed organic texture

animationLanguage.audioCoupling: motion amplitude and bloom intensity scale with audio energy
animationLanguage.notes: Idle motion is always present so the installation never appears frozen.

futureAIModels.abstraction: All models consume the same Style DNA via promptBuilder; provider-specific syntax is handled at the adapter layer.
futureAIModels.notes: Style DNA is model-agnostic. Adding a provider must not require editing this file.
